mentions.name: CodeInput
mentions.description: This product provides tools for PR-Git workflows, including a merge conflicts editor that experiments with semantic diffs. It ships as a GitHub App that detects pull requests with merge conflicts and automatically creates a workspace for resolving them.
mentions.source_excerpt:
https://codeinput.com - Tools for PR-Git workflows

Currently experimenting with semantic diffs for the merge conflicts editor: https://codeinput.com/products/merge-conflicts/demo

You can try by installing the GitHub App which will detect PRs who have a merge conflict and create a workspace for them.
